name: Product card
summary: Product tile for overviews and carousels: image, brand, title, rating, colors, price and an optional button. The whole card is clickable through the title.
use: Product overviews, search results, "You may also like".
avoid: Long descriptions: they belong on the product page.
More than one primary action per card.
anatomy: Media (square) with a badge on the left and a wishlist button on the right.
Price and an optional stock status.
figmaProps: Horizontal for lists and search results.
Sold out: button off, image dimmed, stock status visible.
Show badge / wishlist / rating / swatches / stock / button
Replace the image with an image fill on Media.
reactProps: Required. The title is the link.
Leave alt empty if the image adds nothing to the title.
CSS colors. The number is read out, the dots are not.
behaviour: A click on the card opens the product page. The wishlist and cart buttons sit on top and work on their own.
On hover: a shadow and an underlined title. On keyboard focus: a focus ring around the whole card.
a11y: One tab stop for the card (the title), plus the buttons.
Wishlist button named "Save {title} to wishlist" with aria-pressed.
Price: "Old price … Now …" for screen readers.
content: Short, clear title, without the brand name if it is already in meta.
do: Use the same image ratio for all products in an overview.
dont: A second link in the card next to the title.
Use only color to show "sale": also use the badge.
open: A carousel component for rows of products does not exist yet.
